name: host-actions
title: Media controls that reach the app
summary: Previous / play-pause / next IconButtons and a seek Button: every tap sends the app a named action (hostNamedAction), the seek one with a payload, and the play-pause tap also flips an exported playing variable that swaps the icon.
prompt: Make media controls: previous, play/pause and next buttons; each tap must reach the app, and play/pause must toggle its icon.
teaches: Send the app a tap by name with {"onClick": {"type": "hostNamedAction", "name": "next"}}; the app receives "next" and nothing in the document changes
Attach a payload with "value": a fixed string ({"type": "hostNamedAction", "name": "seek", "value": "90"}); a "@variable" there is sent as the literal text, not its value

Do both from one tap with a list: [{"type": "valueFloatExpressionChange", "target": "@playing", "value": "1 - @playing"}, {"type": "hostNamedAction", "name": "playPause"}], so the app is told and can also read the exported playing

Library IconButton and Button take the same action or list in their onClick param and label the target from label; swap the play and pause icons with two canvases whose visibility is "@playing" and "1 - @playing"

snippets.note: a tap the app receives by name: hostNamedAction "next"
a named action with a payload: "seek" with the fixed string value "90"
one tap, two actions: flip the exported playing (1 - @playing) and tell the app "playPause"
playing: an exported float the app can read, 0 or 1
the icon slot: a box stacking the play canvas (visibility "1 - @playing") and the pause canvas (visibility "@playing")
the status line: two texts in a box, Paused shown by visibility "1 - @playing", Playing by "@playing"

playing.meaning: 1 while playing, 0 while paused; the app can set it to reflect its own state

check.describe: Starts paused (play triangle on the filled button, status "Paused"); a tap on the middle button shows the pause bars and "Playing", and sends the app playPause. Previous, next and the seek button change nothing on screen: their actions go to the app. Resized, the centred row keeps its three 40 dp buttons and the seek button under it.

expect.changed_variables: playing goes from 0 to 1; the play canvas goes (visibility 0) and the pause canvas shows (visibility 1)
expect.host_actions: playPause is sent on the middle button; previous, next and seek (value "90") on the others

pitfalls: An exported variable alone only changes what the app can read; the app is told about a tap only by a hostNamedAction, so a tap that must reach the app carries one (alone or in the onClick list)
hostNamedAction value is a fixed string: "@playing" would arrive as the text "@playing"; to send live state, export the variable and have the app read it when the action arrives
hostNamedAction has no visible effect in a renderer: the inspector's interactions task lists it under the target (HostNamedAction with its name and value text ids); do not expect a variable to change
visibility reads an integer: a float that is exactly 0 or 1 ("@playing") and the integer expression "1 - @playing" both work; a fraction (0.999) would hide the component
Keep the play and pause canvases the same size in one box so the button does not change size when the icon swaps
